content: Official MCP Python SDK (modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk, pypi 'mcp'): connect via ClientSession + stdio_client(StdioServerParameters) for local subprocess servers, or via streamable-http client for a running HTTP MCP server URL. Pattern: async with client session, session.initialize(), session.list_tools(), session.call_tool(name, arguments=dict) -> result.content. Given SigNoz MCP server supports HTTP mode, Agent K should connect over HTTP transport rather than spawning stdio subprocess.
